# Phase 1: Identify Materials Project Identifiers & Properties

Phase 1 translates user requests into Materials Project query filters and property field names.

## 1. Core Identifiers & Search Criteria

Materials Project queries accept specific identifiers:

| Parameter | Type / Format | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `material_ids` | Comma-separated strings (`mp-XXXX`) | Unique MP material ID(s) | `"mp-149,mp-2534"` |
| `formula` | Chemical formula string | Exact reduced or specified chemical formula | `"Fe2O3"`, `"LiFePO4"`, `"Si"` |
| `chemsys` | Hyphen-separated element symbols | Chemical system containing specified elements | `"Li-Fe-O"`, `"Ga-N"`, `"Si-C"` |
| `elements` | Comma-separated element symbols | Materials containing all listed elements | `"Li,Fe,P,O"`, `"Si,O"` |
| `exclude_elements`| Comma-separated element symbols | Materials excluding listed elements | `"Pb,Hg,Cd"` |

### Formatting Rules
- **Material IDs:** Always prefixed with `mp-` (or `mvc-`), e.g., `mp-149`.
- **Chemical Systems (`chemsys`):** Elements joined by hyphens, typically alphabetical (e.g., `Fe-O`, `Li-P-O`).
- **Formulas (`formula`):** Standard IUPAC chemical formula (e.g., `TiO2`, `BaTiO3`).
- **Elements (`elements`):** Proper case element symbols, comma-separated (e.g., `Li,O`).
  - ✗ `chemsys: "Li, Fe, O"`
  - ✓ `chemsys: "Fe-Li-O"` or `chemsys: "Li-Fe-O"`
  - ✗ `elements: "fe,o"`
  - ✓ `elements: "Fe,O"`

---

## 2. Common Property Fields (`_fields`)

Fields must be explicitly requested via `_fields` (comma-separated string). The most commonly queried properties in `materials/summary` include:

### Identification & Composition
- `material_id`: Materials Project ID (e.g., `mp-149`)
- `formula_pretty`: Clean chemical formula string (e.g., `"SiO2"`)
- `formula_anonymous`: Anonymous formula representation (e.g., `"AB2"`)
- `chemsys`: Chemical system string (e.g., `"O-Si"`)
- `elements`: List of elemental constituent symbols
- `nsites`: Total number of sites in unit cell
- `nelements`: Number of distinct elements

### Thermodynamic Stability
- `energy_above_hull`: Energy above the convex hull in eV/atom (0.0 means thermodynamically stable)
- `is_stable`: Boolean indicating if material is on the convex hull
- `formation_energy_per_atom`: Formation energy in eV/atom
- `uncorrected_energy_per_atom`: Uncorrected DFT total energy per atom in eV
- `equilibrium_reaction_energy_per_atom`: Equilibrium reaction energy in eV/atom
- `decomposes_to`: List of decomposition products for unstable materials

### Electronic & Magnetic Properties
- `band_gap`: Band gap in eV
- `is_gap_direct`: Boolean (`True` if direct gap, `False` if indirect)
- `is_metal`: Boolean (`True` if metallic)
- `cbm`: Conduction band minimum in eV
- `vbm`: Valence band maximum in eV
- `efermi`: Fermi energy level in eV
- `is_magnetic`: Boolean
- `ordering`: Magnetic ordering type (`"FM"`, `"AFM"`, `"NM"`, etc.)
- `total_magnetization`: Total magnetic moment per unit cell ($\mu_B$)

### Structural & Mechanical Properties
- `structure`: Complete crystal structure definition (lattice + atomic sites)
- `symmetry`: Space group and crystal system dictionary (e.g. `symmetry.crystal_system`, `symmetry.number`, `symmetry.symbol`)
- `density`: Density in g/cm³
- `volume`: Unit cell volume in Å³
- `bulk_modulus`: Bulk modulus dictionary / Voigt-Reuss-Hill value (GPa)
- `shear_modulus`: Shear modulus dictionary / Voigt-Reuss-Hill value (GPa)
- `universal_anisotropy`: Elastic anisotropy value
- `homogeneous_poisson`: Poisson ratio

### Dielectric & Piezoelectric Properties
- `e_total`: Total dielectric constant
- `e_ionic`: Ionic dielectric contribution
- `e_electronic`: Electronic dielectric contribution
- `n`: Refractive index
- `e_ij_max`: Maximum piezoelectric strain coefficient (C/m²)
- `piezoelectric_modulus`: Piezoelectric modulus

---

## 3. Dedicated Endpoint Properties

When querying specialized sub-endpoints instead of `materials/summary`:
- **`materials/thermo`**: `thermo_id`, `material_id`, `formation_energy_per_atom`, `energy_above_hull`, `is_stable`, `total_energy`, `uncorrected_energy_per_atom`
- **`materials/elasticity`**: `k_voigt`, `k_reuss`, `k_vrh`, `g_voigt`, `g_reuss`, `g_vrh`, `elastic_anisotropy`, `poisson_ratio`
- **`materials/dielectric`**: `e_total`, `e_ionic`, `e_electronic`, `n`
- **`materials/piezoelectric`**: `e_ij_max`, `piezoelectric_modulus`
- **`materials/insertion_electrodes`**: `battery_id`, `average_voltage`, `capacity_grav`, `capacity_vol`, `energy_grav`, `energy_vol`, `stability_charge`, `stability_discharge`

---

## 4. Range Filtering Arguments

Numeric properties can be filtered in queries using min/max tuples or boundary parameters:
- `band_gap_min`, `band_gap_max` / `band_gap`: Range filter
- `energy_above_hull_min`, `energy_above_hull_max`
- `density_min`, `density_max`
- `is_stable`: Boolean filter (`True` / `False`)
- `is_metal`: Boolean filter (`True` / `False`)
